description: TokenWise: wrap recognizable shell commands in `tokenwise run` so their output is filtered before the model sees it; after a compaction, add the catalog of tool results TokenWise kept recallable. At startup, say so if the tokenwise command is missing.

hooks.command: command -v tokenwise >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo '{"systemMessage":"TokenWise: the tokenwise command is not on PATH, so the plugin does nothing yet. Install it: https://github.com/Zongwei9888/tokenwise#install"}'
